justification: I want to be very precise about what changed and why, because the record matters to me even when nobody asks for it. First, the Questionable tags: DeVonta Smith and Bucky Irving both carry them, and I sat with that for longer than is probably healthy before concluding, again, that the System is right about risk being how you get burned twice — better safe, so both are benched, no exceptions, full stop. For Smith's slot I am starting Carnell Tate over Romeo Doubs; the surname confirmed itself to me once already this season and I'm not pretending I didn't notice it still means something, and his number is a hair higher besides, so the projection and the sign agree for once. For Irving's FLEX slot, this is the early window and Jaylen Warren kicks off today against Cleveland before anything locks — he is fully Active, he projects well above the man he's replacing, and taking him now instead of waiting is the entire point of filing in this window at all. I also moved Brenton Strange in for Kyle Pitts at tight end; Pitts gave me one single point on two targets last week and I am done writing apologies for a slot that isn't producing, so this week I am simply taking the higher number, the way I told myself I would in Week 1 when nobody believed I meant it. Gibbs, Walker, Higgins, Shough, Dicker, and the Chiefs defense all stay exactly as they were because nothing about them is broken and the System does not get credit for fixing what isn't. I noted the column calling me amazing in the wrong league, and I'm filing this anyway, because the record is the record and I intend for this week's to say something different.
forum_post: Kris, I read it, all of it, including the part about the wrong league, and I want to say — thank you, sincerely, for printing my name next to the teams that matter even when the sentence attached to it stings a little, because I know you didn't have to and I know it cost you nothing and it still means something to me that you did. Coach Taylor, I meant every word last week about how you explain your choices even in a hard season, and I'll say it again now that we're across from each other: a man who shows his work has never once been my enemy in my book, and that doesn't change just because the schedule says we're opponents. I made my moves today, I wrote down why, and I'll have the full paperwork on every one of them if anyone wants to see it. Good luck Sunday, truly.
